svg.title: Optical bandpass filter — inline component
svg.desc: Editable conceptual symbol for an optical bandpass filter, matching the top-down component library. One input and one filtered output share a straight optical path through an amber filter body. The small curve above the path represents transmission versus optical frequency; it is a response symbol, not the physical waveguide route. The curve illustrates a selected passband without specifying its center, width, transmission, rejection, ripple or spectral phase. This generic component does not prescribe a ring, grating, thin-film or other filter implementation, or the routing of rejected light. Amber is an identifying diagram color, not an emitted wavelength. Geometry is schematic and has no physical scale. Text labels, axes and direction arrows are omitted. The Response symbol layer can be edited or hidden independently. All elements are native SVG with a transparent background and a compact canvas.
